audible.explain: 🎧 Connect your Audible account Audible requires sign-in to check the books in your library and authorize downloads. A link alone does not grant access. Each user connects their own account. Sign in only on the Amazon page: never send your password or verification code to the bot. Afterwards, the bot asks only for the return URL to complete authorization. Your session is stored on the server, separately from other accounts, until you disconnect. The bot can access your library with that session. Use /audible_logout to delete the session and local files. Downloads work in private chats only.
audible.disconnected: Audible disconnected. Your session and local files were deleted. You can also revoke the device in your Amazon settings.
audible.connected:
✅ Your Audible account is connected.

Send the audiobook link to download it. The book must be saved in this account’s library.

To disconnect, use /audible_logout.
audible.email: Send only your Amazon/Audible account email address. Do not send a password or verification code. The email is used to start Amazon sign-in.
audible.browser: 1. Tap Sign in to Amazon and sign in using your browser. 2. Copy the full address-bar URL when finished, even if the final page shows an error. 3. Paste that URL only in this private chat. The bot will try to delete the message after receiving it. Sign-in expires in 10 minutes. Never send your password or verification code to the bot.
audible.private: 🔐 Audible works only in private chats. Each person must connect their own account to access their library.
audible.market: Use /audible followed by your account country: br, us, uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, au, jp or in.
